rule.name: EarlyWaitOnStartedWork
rule.message: This waits for work started earlier (get() or join() on a Future, join() on a Thread), but the result is first used only after later statements that do not use it. While this waits, nothing else runs. Move the wait to where the result is first used, so that the independent work overlaps with the task. An exception fits only when the later work relies on the task having finished (shared state, a file or row the task writes, a required order).
